MAINTENANCE-TASKS.DESCRIPTION: Rebuild derived data and resend integration events to the other services. Every task runs across all organisations.

PRESET.TITLE: Full refresh
PRESET.DESCRIPTION: Rebuild the search index, then resend the touch, accounting and indicator events: {{count}} tasks, one after another. Run it when the release notes of an upgrade ask for it, or when another service is out of sync.

INDEX.TITLE: Search index
INDEX.DESCRIPTION: Rebuild the plan and asset indexes from the database.

TOUCH.TITLE: Touch events
TOUCH.DESCRIPTION: Resend every organisation, user, asset and plan, so the other services catch up.

ACCOUNTING.TITLE: Accounting entries
ACCOUNTING.DESCRIPTION: Recount usage per organisation and send the totals to the accounting service.

KPI.TITLE: KPI indicators
KPI.DESCRIPTION: Recreate the indicators and their data points, and republish the dashboards.
KPI.NOTE: Indicator points are added to what the KPI service already holds. Reset the indicators before sending the points again, or the data is counted twice.

SELECTION.HINT: They run in page order: search index, touch, accounting, then indicators.

CLEAR-INDEX.TITLE: Clear the search indexes
CLEAR-INDEX.DESCRIPTION: Deletes the plan and asset indexes. Search is empty until the index is rebuilt. Never part of a batch.
CLEAR-INDEX.CONFIRM: Delete the plan and asset search indexes? Search stays empty until you rebuild them.

CONFIRM.TITLE: Start this run?
CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: The tasks run one after another on the server, across all organisations. You can leave this page while they run.
CONFIRM.POINTS-WARNING: Indicator points are sent without resetting the indicators first, so the KPI service will count this data twice.
CONFIRM.STOP-ON-FAILURE-HINT: Otherwise the remaining tasks still run, and the failures are listed at the end.

RUN.HINT: The run continues on the server if you leave this page. Stopping waits for the current task to finish.
RUN.INTERRUPTED-HINT: The backend stopped while this run was in progress. Start the remaining tasks again.

CHECKS.FORMAT-NUMBER: {{key}} needs a number, but this is a free-text input, so other answers are dropped. Use a number input.
CHECKS.FORMAT-DATE-TEXT: {{key}} needs a date, but this is a free-text input, so anything that is not a date is dropped. Use a date input.
CHECKS.FORMAT-DATETIME: {{key}} takes a date and time. A date input gives only the date, which is read as midnight (UTC).
CHECKS.FORMAT-CHOICE-YESNO: {{key}} takes one of {{values}}; a Yes / No input can’t give those.
CHECKS.REFERENCE: {{key}} is filled from a picked reference’s own fields; on this input it gives nothing.
CHECKS.CHOICE-VALUES: Answers {{outside}} are not values {{key}} accepts ({{values}}), so they are dropped.
CHECKS.ANSWER-VALUE: Answer “{{answer}}” sets {{key}} to “{{value}}”, which it doesn’t accept ({{values}}).
CHECKS.NOT-IMPORTED: {{key}} is exported but not read back on import.
CHECKS.SPREAD: Questions {{questions}} fill {{object}} with no section or question object, so they export as separate objects. Give the section an object.

DASHBOARD.INFO-TEXT: {{ APP_NAME_CAPS }} is an open extensible service that simplifies the management, validation, monitoring and maintenance and of Plans. It allows actors (researchers, managers, supervisors etc) to create actionable Plans that may be freely exchanged among infrastructures for carrying out specific aspects of the Data management process in accordance with the intentions and commitment of Data owners.
DASHBOARD.INFO-PLAN-TEXT: A Plan (DMP) is a living document describing the items that are generated and/ or re-used during and after a research lifetime.
